title: Viral Infection of HSPC Impacts Hematopoiesis
official: Virus-induced Immunosuppression Via Infection of Hematopoietic Progenitors
summary: We propose to demonstrate that HIV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 are capable of targeting long-lived HSPC with self-renewal capacities. These progenitors, thus transformed into host cells, can give rise to a durable source of infected cells with an impact on hematopoiesis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

HIV patients :

* HIV-positive patients with a negative or positive viral load.
* managed at Ambroise Paré Hospital.
* patients with a bone marrow biopsy or myelogram performed as part of their care.

Healthy subjects without HIV - patients with a BM biopsy or myelogram performed as part of their care for a suspected hematological pathology.

Management at Ambroise Paré Hospital.
